observation.description: The jobs_one_off_v1 admin surfaces are usable only through undocumented custody. GET /_snapback/api/jobs/{id} refuses with SNAPBACK_ADMIN_SECRET_READ_REQUIRED ('a valid secret-read lease is required'); neither the capability-index row (which documents the drain route) nor any guide page mentions the lease, the mint route (/_snapback/api/admin-secret-read/mint), the x-snapback-secret-read-lease header, or the first-class CLI that owns the proof (`snapback secret-read-mint --ready-file ... --token ... --admin-inspect` — ready-file-only because the proof root is local operator authority). This arm discovered the surface by reading packaged binary strings (SecretReadMintEnvelope{lease{scopes,ttlMs,rowBudget,byteBudget}, proof{startupNonce,nonce,issuedAtMs,mac}}, domain snapback/admin-secret-read/mint-proof/v1) before finding the CLI in --help. Two adjacent documentation traps cost iterations: (1) the capability row and define.d.ts say defineJobStatusQuery 'requires the experimental jobs_one_off_v1 target capability, acknowledged by codegen' — but naming it in defineSchema requiredCapabilities refuses as 'unknown required target capability'; the acknowledgment is emitted BY codegen automatically and must not be written; (2) the enqueue options vocabulary (delayMs, idempotencyKey, maxAttempts) and the drain input ({nowMs}) are discoverable only from binary strings and error-driven probing. The missing jobs guide page is already tracked (issues/20260730-move3-jobs-slice-0070.md); this finding pins the specific custody and vocabulary content that page must carry.

competitorOutcome.description: Convex documents scheduled-work observability in one place: system tables readable from functions plus dashboard/CLI views, with no separate lease ceremony to read job status.
competitorOutcome.reference: docs.convex.dev/scheduling (status reads and dashboard visibility documented together)

mustNotRegress: The custody design itself: administrative data reads stay behind operator-minted, ready-file-bound, scoped and budgeted short-TTL leases that can never be discovered from a URL; the admin token alone deliberately does not read secrets.
smallestCoherentFix: The already-owed jobs guide page (capability-index GAP row) covers: ctx.jobs.enqueue options (delayMs, idempotencyKey, maxAttempts) with the SNAPBACK_JOB_* refusal codes, the drain input {nowMs}, job-status reading via `snapback secret-read-mint` + x-snapback-secret-read-lease (and why the lease exists), and a reworded acknowledgment sentence: 'codegen emits the jobs_one_off_v1 acknowledgment automatically — do not add it to requiredCapabilities'.
acceptanceWitness: A clean consumer following only the guide page enqueues a delayed job, force-drains it at an injected clock, and reads its status row without touching binary strings or error-driven probing; the requiredCapabilities sentence no longer produces the unknown-capability refusal path.
